cancellation.target_ownership_changed: Permanent cancellation flag; lock remains through original 33-second expiry.
cancellation.caster_dead_or_currently_captured: Resolution fails live-caster/owner check; lock still expires at 33 seconds.
cancellation.target_dead: No target remains to capture; normal target-owned buff cleanup.
cancellation.target_healed_out_of_threshold_or_left_r: Resolution fails; cooldown is consumed, no refund.
cancellation.player_defeat: No explicit defeated-player constraint exists in pinned action schema. Caster existence/health/ownership guards apply; defeat that leaves a living owned caster is NOT independently rejected.
cancellation.caster_captured_then_recaptured_within_d: Current owner checked at resolution; transient caster ownership loss is not remembered. NOT claimed covered.
cancellation.simultaneous_attempts: Shared preserve-existing target buff and pending-buff exclusion authored; engine ordering still requires multiplayer runtime test.
cancellation.save_reload: Uses native buff lifetime/memory and synchronized random_chance, no external timer; runtime NOT RUN.
